## About the Melbourne event

> ****Join us in Melbourne for NASA’s Space Apps Challenge this November 14/15.****

> ****Sign up to participate now!****

****Who can participate?**** Anyone from students, programmers, technologists and scientists to designers, entrepreneurs, and artists.

****What are the challenges?**** There are challenge categories spanning issues on Earth and in space. More information on the challenges can be found on the Challenges page.

****What do I need to do?**** Register now (space is limited) find a team, pick a project and spend as much time as possible building your solution and preparing your presentation.

****Can I make my team beforehand?**** Yes. Form a group but register individually. We will let you know how you can meet prospective team members online.

****How much does it cost?**** It’s free!

****When is it?**** The event will run from Friday 13 November (welcome and getting ready) through to 11.59pm on Sunday 15 November.

****Where is it?**** The event will be in-person and virtual. The location is [Inspire9](https://www.inspire9.com/) in Richmond ([https://www.inspire9.com/contact](https://www.inspire9.com/contact)).

Thank you to our sponsors for 2026:

## Global steps and deadlines

- **Create Account** (2026-08-26): The first step in your hackathon journey is to create a NASA Space Apps account or log in to your existing account.

- **Register For The Hackathon** (2026-08-26): To participate and be eligible for Global Judging, you must first register for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. You can register up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

- **Choose A Local Event** (2026-08-26): Connect with the NASA Space Apps community by choosing an in-person or virtual Local Event near you. If you don’t have a Local Event near you, choose the virtual Universal Event. You can choose or change your event up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

- **Join Or Form A Team** (2026-09-17): Collaborate with participants by forming or joining a team according to your chosen challenge. Teams should have no more than six participants. You can choose or change your team up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

- **Submit A Project** (2026-11-15): To edit and submit your project, go to the Project Tab on your Team’s page. Project submission opens on Saturday, November 14 at 9:00 AM and closes on Sunday, November 15 at 11:59 PM local time. Submit your project to receive a participant certificate and to be eligible for Global Judging. We encourage all participants to submit what they accomplish over the course of the hackathon.

- **Complete The Participant Survey** (2026-12-01): Share your feedback about your hackathon journey to help improve future events.
